first_layer_token_mean_direction.limits: Optimistic token lookup fitted to all optimized coefficients and their labels; only layer zero is replaced. The original-radius variant retains per-sequence/query radial dependence, which can matter through RMS epsilon. The fixed-radius variant uses unit factorial radius and is strictly token-only in layer zero. Neither is a refitted model, causal generalization test, or proof that optimized coefficients are identifiable.

pca.coordinates: unit direction of r! c_r; positive radius retained during rank reconstruction
pca.limits: PCA target coefficients already used every fitting sequence's labels. Other sequences test basis transfer only. PCA latent coordinates still come from each sequence's optimized table, not a causal input-dependent generator. Rank zero has a fixed direction but retains the original per-sequence/query radius; it is not a strictly static coefficient table when RMS epsilon matters.

limits: Fixed-input fitting diagnostics with different source backbones. These are not held-out LM perplexities. Coefficient-space direction/Jacobian statistics do not directly measure attention-output or loss sensitivity; functional replay supplies the corresponding loss measurements.
